run.brief: You own exactly /Users/deepfates/Hacking/github/deepfates/dspy_elixir/identity/inbox/02-empirical-practice.json. You are not alone in the codebase: do not edit, revert, stage, or reformat any other path, and accommodate concurrent work. Read identity/README.md, identity/atlas.json, identity/schema/portfolio.schema.json, README.md, and docs/DSEX_PHILOSOPHY.md. Create one valid portfolio JSON object at your owned path. Run id must be "run-02-empirical-practice", schema_version 1, atlas_version 1. generator must be {"kind":"agent","name":"empirical instrument and publication safari","provider":"openai","model":"gpt-5.5","reasoning_effort":"high","agent_id":null}. Use an ISO-8601 UTC generated_at. method must be "empirical instrument and publication safari". Preserve the complete brief in run.brief. Set intended_territories to ["science-experiment","measurement-evidence","writing-editing-publishing","uncertainty-probability"], intended_strategies to ["ordinary-object","ordinary-verb","technical-borrowing","compound-portmanteau","descriptive-category"], intended_audiences to ["dspy-gepa-researchers","ml-researchers","eval-research-ops","educators-writers"]. Generate exactly 100 candidate observations with contiguous ordinals 1..100. Exactly 20 should have wildcard true; the others false. Do not rank, filter, deduplicate, check availability, browse, or suppress strange/bad/colliding ideas. Repetition is allowed but seek real morphological and conceptual variety. Every candidate must have surface, rationale, territories, strategies, audience_lenses, architecture_lenses, wildcard; add pronunciation, grammar, etymology, parent_surfaces, known_concerns, and notes only when useful and only with schema-allowed fields. All referenced IDs must exist in atlas.json. Do not use a favorite from conversation or infer a winner. Explore experiments, observatories, instruments, editions, revision, calibration, evidence, uncertainty, and publication. Include both sober scientific and unexpectedly humane registers; mark implications of objective metrics or guaranteed discovery. Validate with jq and report the changed path and candidate count.

candidates.rationale: Frames LM programs as recorded trials whose examples, metrics, and revisions can be opened like a lab notebook.
Combines evaluation with publication, suggesting programs become publishable artifacts through measured revisions.
known_concerns: Could overemphasize metrics as objective truth rather than situated evidence.

candidates.rationale: A compact calibration-derived name for adjusting language-model programs against observed behavior.
candidates.etymology: From calibration and a Latinate brand ending.

candidates.rationale: Presents the system as a field site where program variants are revised and compared under observable conditions.

candidates.rationale: Signals updating beliefs and publishing results, leaning into uncertainty without promising proof.
